adjudication.rationale: In the diff, GoogleCalendarService.createEvent now chooses calendarId via `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId` and falls back to `"primary"` when no match is found. Since `destinationCalendar` is now an array and the code no longer uses any “first/only destinationCalendar externalId” fallback, any destinationCalendar entries lacking `credentialId` (or having a non-matching one) will cause events to be created on the primary calendar even if an `externalId` is present. EventManager’s `createAllCalendarEvents` also has a branch for destinations without `credentialId` that calls `createEvent(c, event)` per credential; with GoogleCalendarService’s new lookup-by-credentialId, this branch will also fall back to `primary` when `credentialId` isn’t populated on the destinationCalendar objects. This is a correctness regression relative to the previous behavior that used destinationCalendar.externalId directly.
